scope: Post-terminal descriptive analysis; final scores and selected example epochs were already observed. Only the three resource cuts and target were predeclared in the original campaign. No prospective-confirmation claim.
primary_clock: original process wall; C1 cumulative process wall preserves its original later sample
per_budget_quality: Maximum recorded D macro-F1 at a completed evaluation at or before the per-fit budget, including explicitly timed before-training evaluation. No observation means null, not zero; no interpolation.
learning_rate_selection: One common LR per core by mean over all three declared seeds, among both original LRs; if any seed is missing that LR has no three-seed mean. Ties choose lower LR. Preserve both rosters and all diagnostic failures.
budget_cost: Actual charged per-fit wall at the cutoff is min(whole recorded chain outer wall, cutoff); sum all six candidates. This is a scoped observed-at-most-budget view, not a claim of matched physical energy or equal granted CPU time.
original_caps: Original-only view retains 100-epoch caps and diagnostic failures. The second view explicitly includes post-cap C1 and its costs. No C2.
final_quality: Common-LR selection by three-seed final best complete-epoch score; HCSN remains budget-censored/adequacy false, even if a descriptive mean can be calculated.
target_time: First observed complete-epoch crossing for each final-selected common-LR seed, using uniform epoch clocks; report median only when all three cross. Noncrossing seeds stay right-censored; before-training evaluations are not target crossings.
memory: Report maximum complete-attempt RSS across all six candidates and continuation; this is an upper bound for RSS up to a target, not measured target-time RSS or GPU VRAM.
CPU: Retain original measured epoch prefixes; C1 cumulative CPU is only a lower bound because original parent exit CPU is missing. Do not invent a cumulative exact CPU or use it to decide a cutoff.
validation: Recompute 11-class macro-F1 and accuracy from every retained confusion matrix.
Bind all49 report hashes to archived source/outer receipts and verify source unchanged.
Reconcile final selected LR/quality/cost against independently reviewed baseline table and six-HCSN terminal summary.
Verify strict increasing original epoch clocks and C1 exact parent-offset/outer bounded intervals.
